Frequently asked questions

What does it cost to use LumosCore?

LumosCore charges 0.2% per trade, reduced to 0.1% if you hold at least 250,000 LUMOS. On top of that Stellar itself charges a network fee of a small fraction of a cent.

Do limit orders cost anything?

No. LumosCore takes no fee on a limit order, because a resting order may never fill and charging upfront would not be fair. You pay only the Stellar network fee, a fraction of a cent, whether or not it fills.

What is the Curated list?

Curated is the set of assets LumosCore has checked and chosen to list. Anyone can issue a token under any ticker on Stellar, so we verify which issuer an asset actually comes from before putting it in front of people.

How do I get an asset onto the curated list?

Apply on the List your token page: pick the network, give the asset code, issuing account, description and logo, and pay $250 in XLM from your own wallet. We review it by hand and verify the issuer. Listing is not automatic, but if we say no you get the whole $250 back.

What happens if my listing is rejected?

You are refunded in full — the same amount of XLM, sent back to the account that paid it — and told why. In effect you only pay if the asset is listed, and most declines are fixable, so reapplying afterwards is fine.

How do I promote my token on LumosCore?

Getting curated puts a token into Trade, into search and onto its own asset page with a verified tick, and funding a pool makes it tradeable. Beyond that you can buy placement at $15 per 1,000 impressions, with a 5,000 minimum, paid in XLM or LUMOS.

What does advertising on LumosCore cost?

$15 per 1,000 impressions, with a minimum buy of 5,000 impressions, so $75 to start. Pay in XLM or LUMOS. Your placement is shown to people already trading Stellar assets, so the impressions are an audience rather than traffic.

How does holding 250,000 LUMOS halve my fees?

Hold 250,000 LUMOS or more and your fee drops from 0.2% to 0.1% across Trade, Pools and the bridge. There is nothing to stake, lock or claim, and LUMOS held in a liquidity pool counts towards the total too.

How the Aptos DEX works

Trade, route, and launch — all on-chain, all self-custodied
01
Trade any Aptos-issued asset
Browse listings, swap with APT, or place limit orders against the on-chain Aptos DEX orderbook. No KYC, no intermediaries — just your wallet and the protocol.
02
Smart path payments
Send one asset, the recipient gets another. Aptos automatically finds the cheapest route across multiple pairs and Anchors — even for pairs without direct liquidity.
03
Launch and list your own token
Issue an asset on Aptos and list it on Aptos DEX in minutes. Seed initial liquidity, add a trustline, and the market is live — no separate venue, no listing fee.
04
You stay in custody
Your wallet signs every trade. No deposits, no withdrawals — assets remain yours throughout. Settlement is on-chain in 3–5 seconds.
Aptos DEX charges roughly 0.0001 APT per operation as a network fee. There are no protocol fees or maker/taker rebates — everyone trades at the same rate.
